expectedResults: Catalog version and contents survive persistence and reload deterministically.
Extensions do not mutate the shipped base catalog.
Override precedence is documented and conflicts are handled deterministically.
objective: Verify the catalog is versioned and durable in Referee, and user extensions preserve base immutability with explicit deterministic precedence.
steps: Persist and reload a versioned base catalog and compare its version and content.
Layer a user extension over the base catalog and verify the base remains unchanged.
Exercise explicit overrides, duplicate symbols, and conflicting definitions.
title: Caliper catalog persistence and extension precedence
